clips.title: The story
paras: Laurna Morninglight sends a young priest to aid a wounded Sentinel south of Dolanaar. The duty tests an initiate's devotion and brings formal recognition in the Sisterhood of Elune.

The Sisterhood of Elune guides kaldorei in worship and helps defend Teldrassil's borders. Sentinel Shaya is wounded while patrolling the wilderness south of Dolanaar, and priest trainer Laurna Morninglight cannot leave her post to help. She asks a newly trained initiate to tend Shaya's wounds and strengthen her with protective magic.

After restoring Sentinel Shaya's vigor, a priest returns to Dolanaar to receive formal robes of office from Laurna Morninglight. The robes mark an acolyte's passage from classroom instruction to practical service that can save lives. For the kaldorei, aiding the Sentinels is both service to Elune and a duty to Teldrassil's safety.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I need your help, friend. I am needed here to train the other students, but you, you can help one of our injured Sentinels just south of Dolanaar. She was hurt patrolling the town and could use our aid. Her name is Shaya.

When you find her, heal her wounds, and then fortify her body with your spells. This will at least protect her from harm longer if she finds trouble. Return to me here after you've done your duty to Elune.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Our spells of Fortify are very powerful, Delor. They allow our companions to take further injury from all types of attacks and survive in situations where they would normally fall. But this is nothing when compared to our abilities to heal. There are no greater healers than a priest--do well to remember that. Your power alone can turn the tides of battle easily.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done well and you have served Elune. For that, I thank you.

Please, take this robe as a token of my thanks. It signifies you have earned your place among our order. If you wish, wear it with pride, but either way, we will always recognize you as one of our own.
Go with Elune, friend, and thank you.
